$schema_note: OnDemand Spatial capability registry — Gate 3 rows. Row fields consumed by server/ondemand/capability-loop.js: id, provider, route, adapter (file; rows without one are never executed), status (PENDING / rendering-only rows are excluded from the catalogue), params (whitelist), required_params, description, coverage, license, attribution.

capabilities.notes: REST agent creation is dashboard-only in the live OnDemand docs (§8; re-confirmed 2026-09-18T07:09:37Z: GET /plugin/v1/list total 0). Status becomes 'live' once the tool is created in the dashboard (OpenAPI: docs/ondemand-workflows/tools/earthquake_search.openapi.json), its pluginId is pasted into ondemand_tool_id, and the end-to-end query invokes it. capabilities.description: Search recent/historical earthquakes (USGS FDSN Event) by time window, magnitude and circle (latitude+longitude+maxradiuskm) or bounding box; returns observed events with UTC time, magnitude, depth, location, tsunami flag.
capabilities.attribution: Earthquake data: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earthquake Hazards Program, FDSN Event Web Service

capabilities.description: Estimate the nautical time zone (UTC offset = longitude/15°, rounded) and local time for a coordinate. Dynamic-capability probe of the capability loop; no upstream call.

license.name: Repository (MIT, computed value — no upstream data)

capabilities.notes: Registered with ZERO frontend changes to prove OnDemand selects a capability purely from this registry (docs/audit/capability-loop-verification.md).
